column3: “People of Israel” is rendered “sons of Israel,” and “clan” “family.”
“I have known” is rendered “I have chosen,” and “visit on you” “punish you for.”
“Met by appointment” is rendered “made an appointment.”
“Snare” is rendered “bait”; “surely not catch” is rendered “captures nothing at all.”
“Is it calamity” is rendered “If a calamity occurs.”
“Who will not prophesy” is rendered “Who can but prophesy?”
“To the fortresses” is rendered “on the citadels,” and “disturbances” “tumults.”
“Straightforwardness” is rendered “what is right,” and “store up” “hoard up.”
“An opponent and around the land” is rendered “An enemy, even one surrounding the land”; NASB supplies “even one.”
“Deliver” is rendered “snatch,” and “silk of a couch” “the cover of a couch”; the meaning of the last word is uncertain.
“To the house of the summer” is rendered “together with the summer house”; “people will snatch away” is rendered “will come to an end.”
